subject: mathematics
title: Grade 5 Mathematics
description: A complete fifth-grade mathematics course emphasizing conceptual models, procedural fluency, explanation, application, and durable mastery. The frozen Grade 5 adaptive mathematics artifact remains an intervention overlay and is not rewritten here.
capstone: Integrated planning capstone with a model, calculations, error checks, written reasoning, and presentation.

subject: english-language-arts
title: Grade 5 English Language Arts
description: A fifth-grade literacy course combining reading, writing, speaking, listening, language, and research. Original practice texts are included; full-length books may be selected from public-domain, licensed, library, or family-approved sources. The frozen Adaptive English artifact remains an intervention overlay.
capstone: A curated literacy portfolio and public-or-private presentation demonstrating growth across genres.

subject: science
title: Grade 5 Science
description: Phenomenon-centered Grade 5 science aligned to Michigan performance expectations, with safe investigations, modeling, data analysis, and engineering.
capstone: A systems investigation and engineering-design exhibition with text-only and no-media alternatives.

subject: social-studies
title: Grade 5 Social Studies
description: A Michigan-aligned Grade 5 U.S. history and geography course from Indigenous societies and early contact through colonization, Revolution, the Constitution, and civic participation.
capstone: A museum-style inquiry exhibition connecting historical evidence to responsible civic participation.

subject: health
title: Grade 5 Health
description: A non-shaming, age-appropriate health course emphasizing accurate concepts, communication, safety, body respect, trusted support, and decision skills.
capstone: A private-safe personal wellness and safety toolkit; no private disclosure or body measurement required.

subject: physical-education
title: Grade 5 Physical Education
description: A varied, inclusive physical-education course that develops motor skills, knowledge, strategy, responsible behavior, and personally meaningful lifelong activity.
capstone: A personal movement portfolio and learner-designed inclusive activity festival.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Grade 5 Ready for Life
description: A full-year Grade 5 practical-life course that references the Director-frozen 12-lesson Ready for Life baseline and adds transfer labs without modifying the frozen artifact.
capstone: A guardian-visible “Finish the Loop” contribution project with checklist, evidence, and reflection.

subject: technology
title: Grade 5 Technology and Computer Science
description: Foundational digital literacy and computer science with strong privacy, source, accessibility, and AI-verification habits.
capstone: A user-centered prototype with algorithm, test log, accessibility check, and presentation.

subject: arts-and-music
title: Grade 5 Arts and Music
description: An integrated arts course developing creation, performance or presentation, response, connection, technique, and respectful cultural context.
capstone: A choice-based arts portfolio and exhibition or private sharing event.

subject: financial-literacy
title: Grade 5 Financial Literacy
description: A practical, family-respectful introduction to earning, spending, budgeting, saving, borrowing, risk, entrepreneurship, and consumer safety.
capstone: A simulated marketplace and personal money-choice portfolio; no real financial accounts or purchases required.

subject: mathematics
title: Grade 7 Mathematics
description: A complete Grade 7 mathematics course centered on proportional reasoning, rational numbers, algebra, geometry, statistics, probability, modeling, and explanation.
capstone: A multi-domain modeling capstone with calculations, representations, limitations, and oral or written defense.

subject: english-language-arts
title: Grade 7 English Language Arts
description: A Grade 7 literacy course building close reading, analytical and creative writing, argument, research, media literacy, language, discussion, and publication.
capstone: A portfolio and inquiry-based communication demonstrating independent reading, writing, source, and presentation skills.

subject: science
title: Grade 7 Science
description: A locally sequenced Grade 7 science course drawn from Michigan’s Grades 6–8 performance-expectation band, emphasizing matter, energy, cells, ecosystems, Earth systems, hazards, and engineering.
capstone: An engineering and evidence exhibition linking a tested design to a scientific model.

subject: social-studies
title: Grade 7 Social Studies
description: A Michigan-aligned Grade 7 world history and geography course from early human societies through major global interactions by about 1500 CE, with civic inquiry and respectful treatment of cultures and belief systems.
capstone: A comparative world-history inquiry exhibition using maps, sources, argument, and a civic reasoning connection.

subject: health
title: Grade 7 Health
description: A Grade 7 health course emphasizing health literacy, body respect, mental health, relationships and consent, substance-risk reduction, sexual-health foundations, and help-seeking.
capstone: A private-safe wellness, communication, and safety portfolio grounded in reliable information and trusted support.

subject: physical-education
title: Grade 7 Physical Education
description: An inclusive Grade 7 physical-education program combining motor competence, tactical understanding, health-enhancing activity, leadership, and lifelong participation.
capstone: A personal lifetime-activity portfolio and learner-led inclusive activity experience.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Grade 7 Ready for Life
description: A Grade 7 practical-life course extending the “Finish the Loop” philosophy into planning, home systems, food preparation, communication, digital consumer skills, and contribution.
capstone: A multi-step contribution project with permission, safety, execution, handoff, and reflection evidence.

subject: technology
title: Grade 7 Technology and Computer Science
description: A Grade 7 computer-science and technology course covering programming, web design, data, cybersecurity, research, accessibility, and responsible AI use.
capstone: An accessible human-centered digital product with source, test, privacy, and impact documentation.

subject: arts-and-music
title: Grade 7 Arts and Music
description: An integrated Grade 7 arts course emphasizing visual design, music, theatre/media, dance, cultural context, critique, production, and portfolio development.
capstone: A curated cross-arts portfolio, performance, exhibition, or private digital gallery.

subject: financial-literacy
title: Grade 7 Financial Literacy
description: A middle-grades financial-literacy course introducing Michigan personal-finance strands through realistic simulations and consumer protection.
capstone: A one-year fictional financial plan and oral or written defense; no real account data or individualized financial advice.

subject: mathematics
title: Grade 8 Mathematics
description: A complete Grade 8 mathematics course emphasizing real numbers, exponents, linear equations, functions, systems, transformations, geometry, bivariate data, and modeling.
capstone: An algebraic modeling capstone with data, equations or functions, geometry, assumptions, verification, and presentation.

subject: english-language-arts
title: Grade 8 English Language Arts
description: A Grade 8 literacy course preparing learners for high-school reading, writing, research, argument, rhetoric, discussion, language, media analysis, and independent publication.
capstone: A curated transition portfolio and formal defense with private presentation options.

subject: science
title: Grade 8 Science
description: A locally sequenced Grade 8 science course drawn from Michigan’s Grades 6–8 performance-expectation band, covering forces, waves, heredity, evolution, Earth history, space, resources, and engineering.
capstone: A research or engineering defense using models, data, tradeoffs, revisions, and clear limitations.

subject: social-studies
title: Grade 8 Social Studies
description: A Michigan-aligned Grade 8 U.S. history and geography course from constitutional foundations through the early republic, expansion, reform, sectional crisis, Civil War, Reconstruction, and an introduction to 1870–1898.
capstone: A constitutional-history inquiry exhibition and civic reasoning project using primary and secondary evidence.

subject: health
title: Grade 8 Health
description: A Grade 8 health course supporting high-school readiness through health literacy, body-respectful wellness, mental-health support, relationships and consent, substance-risk reduction, sexual health, and advocacy.
capstone: A fact-checked health communication and self-advocacy portfolio with protected privacy.

subject: physical-education
title: Grade 8 Physical Education
description: An inclusive Grade 8 physical-education program emphasizing competence, strategy, fitness literacy, leadership, stress management, and transition to independent lifelong activity.
capstone: A lifelong-movement transition plan, portfolio defense, and learner-facilitated inclusive event.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Grade 8 Ready for Life
description: A Grade 8 practical-life transition course extending “Finish the Loop” into planning, home operations, cooking, transportation, appointments, work readiness, and independent-living simulation.
capstone: A one-month independent-living simulation reviewed for safety, feasibility, communication, and backup planning.

subject: technology
title: Grade 8 Technology and Computer Science
description: A Grade 8 computer-science and technology course preparing learners for high-school work in programming, web/app design, data science, cybersecurity, AI literacy, and human-centered impact analysis.
capstone: A documented technology capstone with source, code or logic, testing, accessibility, privacy, security, and impact evidence.

subject: arts-and-music
title: Grade 8 Arts and Music
description: An integrated Grade 8 arts program focused on artistic voice, design and media, music, theatre/film, cultural ethics, collaboration, and high-school-ready portfolio presentation.
capstone: A polished cross-arts portfolio and public-or-private capstone presentation.

subject: financial-literacy
title: Grade 8 Financial Literacy
description: A 72-session Grade 8 personal-finance course covering Michigan PF1–PF7 expectations through realistic simulations. It is designed around the published high-school content expectations. Under Michigan guidance, middle-school instruction must count for the half credit when those expectations are presented and the learner demonstrates proficiency; this curriculum package alone does not document an individual learner’s completion or proficiency.
capstone: A comprehensive one-year fictional financial plan and oral or written defense.
